copy.tagline: 生成小红书风格的竖版图文卡片

copy.tagline_en: Generate vertical image cards in Xiaohongshu style
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create vertical image cards in Xiaohongshu style

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成 9 页 3:4 竖版图文轮播（小红书/Instagram Carousel），包含封面、内容页和尾页 CTA。采用暖色 pastel 背景，虚线 sticker 卡片，底部页码点。
howto.when: 当你要求制作小红书或 Instagram 的轮播图文时触发，例如说“帮我做一个小红书图文”或“设计一个 Instagram carousel”。

say.text: 帮我生成一篇小红书图文，介绍新出的防晒霜。
say.note: Claude 生成9页轮播图，包含封面、使用场景、功效等。

say.text: 做一份9页的Instagram carousel，推广春季旅行。
say.note: Claude 创建带封面、目的地、贴士和行动号召的轮播。

say.text: 设计一个小红书图文，封面突出‘新手必看’，要点分页。
say.note: Claude 构建以封面吸引点击，内容逐页展示的轮播。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate a 9-page 3:4 vertical graphic carousel (Xiaohongshu/Instagram Carousel), including cover, content pages, and ending CTA. It uses warm pastel background, dashed sticker cards, and bottom page dots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a Xiaohongshu or Instagram carousel post, e.g., 'help me create a Xiaohongshu graphic post' or 'design an Instagram carousel'.

say_en.text: Create a Xiaohongshu post about a new sunscreen.
say_en.note: Claude generates 9 slides with cover, usage tips, and effects.

say_en.text: Make a 9-page Instagram carousel promoting spring travel.
say_en.note: Claude produces carousel with cover, destinations, tips, and CTA.

say_en.text: Design a Xiaohongshu carousel with 'must-see for beginners' cover.
say_en.note: Claude builds a carousel with eye-catching cover and detailed tips.
